sentences.text:
IN CR.MA NO.9526/2015 The application is tendered for condonation of delay to assail the judgment and order dated 23.01.2014 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Morbi recording acquittal of the opponents for the offence punishable under Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954.
It is explained in Paragraph-4 that the applicant had administrative reasons for filing the delayed leave to appeal.
The averments aforestated are not controverted by the opponents.
ORAL ORDER IN CR.MA NO.9523/2015 Leave to Appeal is granted.
Accordingly, the application is disposed of.
